stories.completed: Done. You reached the final study summary screen.

items.title: Create medical flashcards
items.description: Create a deck, add two basic cards and study them through to the summary.
steps: Tap “Add deck” and create a new set.
Add the first basic card and tap “Next”.
Add the second card and tap “Save” to return to the deck.
Tap “Study” in the top-right corner of the deck.
Go through the cards until the summary screen.

items.title: Turn pharmacology notes into cloze cards
items.description: Create a deck, add one cloze card and finish a short study session.
steps: Tap “Add deck” and create a new set.
Select part of the text, use cloze and tap “Save”.
Tap “Study” in the top-right corner of the deck.
Go through study until the summary screen.

items.title: Review before a colloquium
items.description: Start studying from an example deck and reach the repeat-or-exit choice.
steps: Tap “Study” on one of the example decks.
Rate each card as “I know” or “I don't know”.
On the final screen, choose repeat or return to the deck.

fixedScreens.label: Decks
fixedScreens.title: Three subjects, zero study clutter
fixedScreens.description: Anatomy, pharmacology and pathology stay organized in focused decks. Tags make it easy to find exactly what belongs to a topic or exam.

fixedScreens.label: Flashcards
fixedScreens.title: Use the right format for every fact
fixedScreens.description: Mix classic questions, cloze deletions, images and image occlusion in the same deck. Everything stays organized and ready to study.

fixedScreens.label: Cloze deletion
fixedScreens.title: Turn notes into active recall
fixedScreens.description: Select a key phrase and Fishki turns it into a cloze while keeping the answer on the back. No need to rewrite the same fact twice.

fixedScreens.label: Smart reviews
fixedScreens.title: Review at the right moment
fixedScreens.description: Fishki builds your queue with FSRS. Rate each answer with a simple gesture, and the app schedules the next review for the right time.

fixedScreens.label: Images
fixedScreens.title: Study from diagrams that explain the mechanism
fixedScreens.description: Add an image to either side of a card. Fishki keeps the full graphic visible, so important structures and labels are never cropped away.

fixedScreens.label: Image occlusion
fixedScreens.title: Test structures without revealing the answer
fixedScreens.description: Cover a node, vessel or part of a specimen and identify it from memory. Flip the card to reveal the complete image and the marked location.

fixedScreens.label: Daily plan
fixedScreens.title: Open Fishki and know what to study today
fixedScreens.description: FSRS and the exam planner combine new cards, due reviews and difficult material into one realistic daily plan.

steps.title: Choose editing or start studying
steps.description: Every deck has a separate action for managing cards and starting a study session quickly.

steps.title: See its cards and add another
steps.description: Opening a deck shows its flashcards. The floating button opens the new-card editor directly.

steps.title: Enter the question and answer
steps.description: The editor stays simple while supporting formatting, images and serious medical content.

steps.title: Choose how you want to study
steps.description: Choose free-form quick study or smart reviews scheduled by FSRS. Both modes share the same progress.

steps.title: Move through material without extra ratings
steps.description: Flip the card and choose only “I know” or “I don't know”.

steps.title: See your session result
steps.description: Check mastery and repeat only the cards you missed when needed.

proof.heading: Built around how medical students actually study
proof.footer: Medical students told us the same things repeatedly: creating cards takes too long, images are awkward to use, review systems feel cumbersome and offline study is unreliable. Fishki tackles those problems directly.

quotes.name: Hannah
quotes.quote: I want reviews like in Anki, but with simpler syncing between my phone, computer and offline mode.

quotes.name: Kate
quotes.quote: The best option would combine Anki and Quizlet: quick review and regular spaced repetition.

quotes.name: Adam
quotes.quote: I would like more control: changing intervals, shuffling flashcards and easily swapping the question and answer.

faq.answer: No. Private beta testing is free and optional. Fishki may invite preorder customers before launch, but a purchase does not guarantee an invitation.

faq.question: Will the subscription renew automatically?
faq.answer: No. This is a one-time payment for 12 months of Premium from public launch; the preorder does not renew automatically.

faq.question: What if launch is delayed?

preorderTerms.title: Fishki Premium 12-Month Subscription Preorder and Sales Terms

blocks.text: The seller of the Fishki Premium 12-month subscription preorder is:
Mateusz Buczak, operating as an unregistered business activity under Polish law
Address: ul. Ks. Alojzego Koziełka 106, 44-190 Knurów, Poland
Contact email: support@fishki-med.com
Hereinafter: the “Seller”.

Fishki is an educational application being developed for medical students. Its purpose is to make creating flashcards, studying with reviews, working with visual materials and planning study for tests, exams and final exams easier.

Fishki is a product under development. The subject of this agreement is the preorder of an annual Fishki Premium subscription, not access to a test version or the purchase of a finished app on the payment date.

sections.title: 3. Subject of the agreement and optional beta testing

blocks.text: The subject of the agreement is a preorder for a 12-month Fishki Premium subscription. The subscription period starts on the public launch date, when Fishki becomes available to all users. The purchase does not start the paid Premium period before that date.
The buyer makes a one-time payment for one 12-month Premium period. The preorder does not renew automatically or create further payments.

Before public launch, the Seller may additionally invite the buyer to free, private beta testing on a selected platform. Participation is voluntary, depends on invitation availability, and is neither the subject of the sale nor a condition for starting or retaining the Premium subscription. Purchasing the preorder does not guarantee a beta invitation.
No invitation, declining testing or the end of testing does not shorten the purchased 12 months of Premium from public launch.
The preorder price depends on the user's region and is: PLN 69 in Poland, €16.99 in Europe outside Poland or $18.99 in the United States and other countries.
The planned annual price after the public launch is respectively: PLN 149 in Poland, €49.99 in Europe outside Poland or $59.99 in the United States and other countries.
This is a one-time payment solely for the preorder of a 12-month Fishki Premium subscription. Any beta testing invitation is free.
The Seller may change the preorder price or end its sale in the future. A price change does not affect people who purchased the preorder before the change.
The public launch of Fishki is planned by the end of 2026. The purchased 12-month Fishki Premium period starts on that date.

The full version of the application means that Fishki is made publicly available to all users. This term does not guarantee the implementation of any specific feature or an unchanged feature scope, as Fishki will continue to evolve after its public launch.
The planned launch date may change because the application is still under development.
If the application does not officially launch by March 31, 2027, every purchaser may request a full refund of the amount paid for the preorder within two months of that date.
Planned Fishki development includes in particular:

items: statistics, import, a public library and sharing features at later stages.

blocks.text: This list describes the product direction and does not guarantee that every feature will be available on the public launch date. The right to use the Premium plan for 12 months remains the subject of the agreement.

items: clicking the purchase button on the website,

blocks.text: After payment, the buyer will see an order confirmation; the payment provider may email a transaction confirmation to the address provided. The Seller will share details of the purchased Premium subscription before or on the public launch date.

The buyer should provide a current and accurate email address. It will be used to link the Premium subscription and communicate about the preorder, any free beta testing invitation, refunds and complaints.
A user who is a consumer may withdraw from the agreement within 14 days of purchasing the preorder without giving a reason.
